area.source: GOB stores the selected-hostile centre and 8 m radius without a persistent area object.
area.runtime: AbilityTargets and PvpCombat use the admitted target position and check same-district, eligible visible recipients with individual viral rolls.
area.test: DespoilerFieldsLandOnTheSelectedEnemyAndExactRadiusEdge checks 8.00 m inclusion, 8.01 m exclusion, ally and unseen exclusion, and a successful secondary when the primary deflects. HackerDespoilerAreaControlsMode uses the exact known stock Code Nuke companion in the disposable setup.

targeting.source: GOB 399/400 stores selected hostile selector 3, reach 14 metres, Hacker Style and TestFunction 2. CastWhenUsed is 1 for 399 and 2 for 400.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler checks a visible, living selected opponent before the cast cost and revalidates the admitted view/spawn and reach before landing. PvpCombat and AbilityTargets check sight and resolve a separate viral test for each recipient.
targeting.test: DespoilerAreasValidateTheOriginalSelectionBeforeItsSplash covers selected ally, empty, hidden, range, unloaded, style, combat and paid invalidation. DespoilerFieldsLandOnTheSelectedEnemyAndExactRadiusEdge covers independent primary deflection and successful edge splash.

damage.source: GOB 400 stores one non-piercing ViralDOT modifier, fixed pool 59, 15 s, 2.5 s cadence, DamageType 2. The shipped ViralDOT callback applies per-interval damage until expiry. [ViralDOT](../research/client-scripts/tempmods.py#L896)
damage.runtime: TimedEffects scales the stored pool with active and loaded Viral Damage before installation. Each actual tick uses current TypedAbilityResistance.
damage.test: PlagueZoneAppliesFiveActualHealthTicksAndThenStops verifies the unscaled 59 pool and five ticks of 10. DespoilerFieldsLandOnTheSelectedEnemyAndExactRadiusEdge verifies 74 from the legal level-30 Hacker profile, five ticks of 12, two ticks reduced to 10 on the edge player under +43 Viral Resistance and restored ticks after resistance expiry. No sixth tick or immediate health damage.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 400 stores 15 IS, a two-second cast, 12 s reuse and one 15 s ViralDOT component. CastWhenUsed 2 permits combat, and no health-hit component is stored.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler validates and charges the selected-cast request, retains target identity through the cast, and uses the existing own reuse and selected splash. TimedEffects implements the sourced DOT and participant-specific expiry.
behavior-tests.test: DespoilerAreasValidateTheOriginalSelectionBeforeItsSplash verifies charged in-combat cast and reuse with no orphan splash. DespoilerFieldsLandOnTheSelectedEnemyAndExactRadiusEdge verifies full tick lifetime, isolated recipients and both viral contest outcomes. Complete stock 400 input remains the native-family check.
